name: BZP
summary: A stimulant that was sold as "legal ecstasy (MDMA)" in the late 2000s, and was one of the first drugs widely marketed as a "research chemical." It has a reportedly less favourable effect profile and has fallen out of popularity greatly since it was banned in many countries.

helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: BZP has been shown to have a mixed mechanism of action, acting on the serotonergic and dopaminergic receptor systems in a similar fashion to MDMA. BZP has amphetamine-like actions on the serotonin reuptake transporter, which increase serotonin concentrations in the extracellular fluids surrounding the cell and thereby increasing activation of the surrounding serotonin receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Norepinephrine–dopamine releasing agent; Serotonin receptor agonist; Stimulant

uses.text: Benzylpiperazine (BZP), also known as 1-benzylpiperazine, is a substance often used as a recreational drug and is known to have euphoriant and stimulant properties.

summaryZh: 1-苄基哌嗪是一種有機化合物，化學式為C11H16N2。它可由哌嗪和氯化苄或溴化苄反應得到，反應中生成的二苄基哌嗪副產物可以通過結晶除去。

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include a racing heart, raised blood pressure, headache, nausea, vomiting, sweating, anxiety and sleeplessness lasting into the next day. It can cause seizures, and heavy use has led to hospital admissions.
sideEffects.zh: 回報的反應包括心跳急促、血壓升高、頭痛、噁心、嘔吐、出汗、焦慮，以及延續到隔天的失眠。它可能引起癲癇發作，大量使用曾導致住院。
sideEffects.zhHans: 回报的反应包括心跳急促、血压升高、头痛、恶心、呕吐、出汗、焦虑，以及延续到隔天的失眠。它可能引起癫痫发作，大量使用曾导致住院。

fact.en: BZP was once patented as a treatment for intestinal worms in farm animals before anyone took it as a stimulant. In New Zealand it was legal and widely sold for years, which produced unusually detailed data on it.
fact.zh: BZP 曾被申請專利用於治療農場動物的腸道寄生蟲，之後才有人把它當作興奮劑使用。它在紐西蘭曾合法且廣泛販售多年，因此留下了異常詳盡的資料。
fact.zhHans: BZP 曾被申请专利用于治疗农场动物的肠道寄生虫，之后才有人把它当作兴奋剂使用。它在新西兰曾合法且广泛贩售多年，因此留下了异常详尽的数据。
